articles.title: PoK youth crosses LoC after social media romance, apprehended by Army
articles.summary: A 22-year-old youth, Zeeshan Mir, from across the border, crossed the heavily fortified Line of Control in North Kashmir's Uri sector. His motive was a social media-sparked love.
